gh-no-shellopenshell2026-10-08 16:39 UTCNot pinnedThis venue has no sandbox shell: pi-dispatch sandbox cannot reopen its runs.

Retention window: 24 hours (24 by default). Each workspace holds the run's clone, prompt.md and event.json (issue text). Open shells are listed on the operator’s Sandboxes tab from the terminal’s live registration.

pi-dispatch sandbox --list

build3

Open Sandboxes

Open in your terminal

The SSH target uses the worker's account, including rootless Podman. Absolute executable paths and the deployment directory load that deployment's sandbox settings after SSH connects. An SSH alias can set its port and identity.

Download opener hosts. Inspect this credential-free file, then import it on your computer:

pi-dispatch opener install --config sandbox-hosts.json

A link cannot change the opener's trusted hosts.
